sensitive_terms: analyzing text with the natural language toolkit
Analyzing Text with the Natural Language Toolkit

runner.install_command: export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive && apt-get update -qq && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends python3 python3-pip python3-setuptools && printf '[global]\nbreak-system-packages = true\n' > /etc/pip.conf && _cb_pip(){ "$1" -m pip install --no-cache-dir --break-system-packages --disable-pip-version-check 'pytest>=6.0.1' pytest-mock 'regex>=2021.8.3' defusedxml click 'joblib>=1.0.1' 'tqdm>=4.59.0'; } && _cb_boot(){ "$1" -c "import base64,sys; exec(base64.b64decode('').decode())"; } && _cb_pip python3 && _cb_boot python3 && if [ -x /usr/bin/python3 ] && [ "$(readlink -f /usr/bin/python3)" != "$(readlink -f "$(command -v python3)")" ]; then _cb_pip /usr/bin/python3 && _cb_boot /usr/bin/python3; fi && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/* && mkdir -p /opt/models && cp -a /opt/cb-cache/data/lingora-models/. /opt/models/ && test -n "$(ls -A /opt/models)" && python3 -c "import regex, click, joblib, defusedxml, tqdm, pytest"
runner.env_probe_command: PYTHONPATH=. python3 -c "from lingora.tokenize import sent_tokenize; sents = sent_tokenize('Good muffins cost $3.88 in New York. Please buy me two of them. Thanks.'); assert len(sents) == 3"
